top_choice_rationale: P001 credits a prediction (Bistritzer and MacDonald's flat bands at a magic angle) and the decisive experiment (Jarillo-Herrero's correlated insulators and gate-tunable superconductivity), both inside the three names. The discovery is the existence of those phases, which many groups and several moire platforms have reproduced; the open pairing mechanism limits what the citation may claim, not whether a discovery was made. P003 is the mature, better-confirmed fallback but carries a compound credit (Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang, Hasan) and sits near the 2016 topology prize. P002 is cleanly attributed but, in my judgement, refines the metrology honoured in 2005 and 2012. A prize is better than none, so P000 is last.
recusal_note: My work on electronic structure of two-dimensional materials and magnetism is adjacent to twisted bilayer graphene; no documented personal or institutional tie to MacDonald, Jarillo-Herrero or Bistritzer is apparent from profile. Not treated as a recusal matter.
